user.title: Create a wallet
user.description: Configure a wallet with market valors valued via Yahoo Finance. Dated contributions can be added after the wallet has been created.

data.expected_annual_return: Expected annual return for the compound target (%)
data.expected_annual_inflation: Expected annual inflation for future purchasing-power forecasts (%)

add_contribution.title: Add a contribution
add_contribution.description: Record a deposit in the base currency. Future dates create planned cash deposits, included in today's forecast but not today's capital. Immediate investment is available only up to today. The next active plan with cash reinvestment enabled can invest a planned deposit when due.

data.add_another: Add another contribution after this one

edit_contribution_fields.title: Edit a contribution

add_lot.title: Import a historical purchase lot
add_lot.description: Record a purchase funded by existing cash. This never creates another deposit. Yahoo estimates units from the first confirmed close on or after the chosen date. Alternatively enter price or actual units. Select opening balance only if those units are already entered.

data.unit_price: Effective unit price in base currency (optional Yahoo fallback)
data.included_in_opening: Purchased units are already included in the configured opening balance

edit_lot_fields.title: Correct a purchase lot
edit_lot_fields.description: Purchase lot: {lot}. Changing the amount or units recalculates its effective purchase price.

data.included_in_opening: These units are already included in the configured opening balance

add_dividend.title: Add a dividend credit
add_dividend.description: Enter the net amount actually credited by the broker. It increases the cash balance and can be included proportionally in the next savings-plan execution.

data.value_date: Value date (optional; used for the cash balance)
Value date (optional; used for the cash balance)

add_plan.title: Add a monthly savings plan
add_plan.description: For percentage allocation, enter the total monthly amount. For fixed allocation, the total is calculated from the individual amounts.

data.name: Plan name
data.amount: Total monthly amount (required only for percentage allocation)
data.use_cash_balance: Include available cash and dividends in the allocation
data.opening_included: Earlier plan purchases are already included in the opening balance

edit_plan_fields.title: Edit a savings plan
edit_plan_fields.description: Keeping fixed allocations scales their amounts to the edited total. Choose whether changes affect only future executions or also recalculate eligible automatic bookings. Manual corrections remain protected.

data.name: Plan name
data.amount: Total monthly amount (required only for percentage allocation)
data.use_cash_balance: Include available cash and dividends in the allocation
data.opening_included: Earlier plan purchases are already included in the opening balance

plan_allocation.title: Plan allocation
plan_allocation.description: {symbol}: Asset {index} of {count}. Enter {unit}. Current total: {current_total}. Percentages must sum to 100; fixed amounts must match the entered total, if any.

remove_plan.title: Remove a savings plan
remove_plan.description: Historical executions remain in the wallet.

restore_execution.title: Restore a skipped execution
restore_execution.description: The monthly execution will be created on the next refresh once confirmed closing prices are available.

data.target_share: Target share (%; 0 is a target, clear the field to remove it)

data.amount: New opening balance (tracked plan purchases are added automatically)
data.target_share: Target share (%; 0 is a target, clear the field to remove it)

plan_opening.title: Opening-balance cutoff
plan_opening.description: Choose the last purchase date already covered by the opening units. Later purchases add units. A future cutoff is not allowed.

data.opening_cutoff_date: Purchases through this date are included

plan_symbols.title: Select plan assets
plan_symbols.description: Choose all assets for this plan. The next step asks for each allocation.

plan_confirm.title: Save and process savings plan

data.legacy_executions: Older executions explicitly approved for recalculation

plan_result.title: Savings-plan result

contribution_investment.title: Allocate this deposit
contribution_investment.description: Choose assets and a default purchase date. Each purchase may use a different date in the next step. Fixed amounts can leave cash uninvested. Percentages must sum to 100.

data.included_in_opening: Units already included in the opening balance

contribution_allocation.title: Purchase
contribution_allocation.description: {symbol}: Asset {index} of {count}: enter the allocation in {unit}. Leave both price and units empty to estimate from Yahoo. Otherwise enter either the effective price or actual units. Future purchases are not allowed.

data.unit_price: Effective unit price in the base currency (optional)

contribution_confirm.title: Save deposit and purchases

lot_confirm.title: Confirm purchase

confirm_remove_contribution.title: Confirm deletion

plan_contribution.title: Plan a future deposit
plan_contribution.description: Plan a future one-off deposit. Until its date it appears only in planning and forecasts. On that date it becomes settlement cash, which the next active plan with cash reinvestment enabled invests in addition to its monthly rate. My Wallet does not transfer money or place broker orders.

error.invalid_symbol: Please enter a valid Yahoo Finance symbol.
error.symbol_exists: This symbol is already in the wallet.
error.target_sum_exceeded: The sum of target shares would exceed 100%.
error.allocation_exists: This valor is already allocated in the plan.
error.invalid_plan: The plan is incomplete. Percentage allocations must total exactly 100%.
error.currency_change_blocked: The base currency cannot be changed while contributions, dividends, or savings plans exist.
error.historical_price_unavailable: Yahoo has no close for this date range. Enter the effective unit price manually.
error.historical_fx_unavailable: Yahoo has no historical exchange rate for this purchase. Enter an effective unit price in the wallet's base currency manually.
error.valor_in_use: This valor is referenced by a purchase lot, dividend, or savings plan. Remove or edit those records first.
error.included_units_exceeded: Lots marked as included exceed this valor's configured opening units. Increase the opening units or clear the included checkbox.
error.invalid_number: Enter a finite value within the allowed range.
error.contribution_date_after_lot: The contribution date cannot be later than a purchase lot retained in this contribution.
error.legacy_opening_required: A legacy opening-balance lot must remain marked as already included in the opening balance.
error.funding_contribution_invalid: The selected funding contribution is unavailable or cannot fund this purchase date.
error.opening_cutoff_future: The opening-balance cutoff cannot be in the future.
error.future_date: Future dates are only available for standalone cash deposits, not purchases, dividends or savings-plan bookings.
error.price_or_units: Enter price or units, not both.
error.allocation_total_mismatch: Percentages must total 100; fixed amounts must match the entered total.
error.insufficient_cash: The allocation is not covered by the deposit and selected available cash at every purchase date.
error.booking_failed: Calculation failed; existing bookings remain unchanged.
error.planned_date_required: Choose a date after today for a planned deposit.
error.planned_investment: Future deposits cannot be invested now. Leave immediate investment disabled; an active savings plan can invest the cash when due.
error.cash_conflict: This change would leave a recorded purchase unfunded. Check the deposit date and amount; existing bookings were preserved.
